real_use_case: Create the minimum E1A CanonicalInterpretationObject after CanonicalGenomicModel and EvidenceSnapshot without performing a new clinical pathogenicity classification.
upstream_status: Project-owned deterministic projection over already verified canonical model and evidence snapshot contracts; no new mutable external source is introduced.
license: Independent project-owned implementation; no third-party implementation or data bytes are copied.
supported_profile: One E1A canonical small-variant model plus its exact minimum ClinVar EvidenceSnapshot and an explicit as-of date.
resource_budget: O(number of canonical variants plus evidence items); no network, subprocess, external database, or new dependency.
input_fixture: Synthetic canonical model and evidence snapshot objects constructed in tests/test_canonical_interpretation_capability.py.
output_contract: CanonicalInterpretationObjectResult with one source-attributed typed interpretation item per canonical variant, explicit evidence freshness, unresolved conflict state, and explicit negative-scope statuses.
known_issues: ACMG/AMP classification, ClinGen/VCEP criteria application, gene-disease validity, mode of inheritance, actionability, phenotype/personal relevance, diagnosis, treatment, and confirmation policy are intentionally not performed by this capability.
security: Fails closed on malformed upstream dataclasses, model/snapshot provenance mismatch, canonical-variant mismatch, cardinality mismatch, invalid/future evidence timestamps, and malformed source-evidence identity.
disable_path: This capability is not wired to a default pipeline; refuse projection unless both upstream artifacts are verified and exactly cross-bound.
